run_pascal_part_mat2json: run the pascal_part_mat2json module to convert MATLAB part annotations to COCO-format JSON
run_pascal_part_mat2json_base: run the pascal_part_mat2json module with --only_base flag to use base categories only
run_pascal_part_mat2json_custom_split: run the pascal_part_mat2json module with custom split_path, split, ann_path, and ann_out arguments
convert_mask2json: convert a binary part mask to COCO RLE segmentation and bounding box format using mask2json
summarize_mask2json: summarize the mask2json function that encodes numpy arrays to COCO RLE format and computes bounding boxes
